test_title: SSC Stenographer 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 10 Dec, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Parts of sentences are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the parts in the correct order to form a meaningful paragraph. The first part 'R.' is fixed.

R. Men usually make more decisions

A. and certainly the most important ones

B. earning a livelihood in most parts of the world

C. since men play a bigger role in

D. they have a major say in economic matters
solution:
The correct answer is** Option (4)** i.e. **ACBD**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence begins with the subject "Men usually make more decisions," which is correctly indicated by **part (R).**** **
 
• Following the subject, "and certainly the most important ones" **(A)** continues the logical sequence, making it clear what kind of decisions men make.
 
• **The next part,** "since men play a bigger role in" **(C)** provides a reason for the previous statement.
 
• **Later, **"earning a livelihood in most parts of the world" **(B) **explains the role men play.
 
• Ending with, "they have a major say in economic matters" **(D) **completes the sentence by stating the context of men.

Therefore, the correct answer is **ACBD.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1 (DCAB):** This option starts with "they have a major say in economic matters" which does not logically follow from the fixed part.
 
• **Option 2 (ACDB):** This option places "since men play a bigger role in" before "earning a livelihood in most parts of the world," which makes the sentence awkward.
 
• **Option 3 (BADC):** This option starts with "earning a livelihood in most parts of the world" which does not logically follow from the fixed part.
